name: motif_why_not
description:
Why a word did not parse. Asks PanGloss whether a word parses as each morph sequence you expected, and for a rejection names the first failing constraint, the morphs and the grammar object it is about. Use it to see why a word did not parse as these morphs.
Command: why-not. Agent class: Evaluate.
word: The exact word form.
expect: One to 16 candidates, each morph,morph|morph,…; see the why-not Help page for the spelling.
at: baseline (the default) for the current published Baseline, or a Proposal id for its latest Trial copy.

word.description: The word that did not parse as expected.

expect.description: One to 16 expected morph sequences. Write each as morph ids in surface order, ',' between positions and '|' between choices at a position, such as 'kib,ak|ik,ek'. Name an entry by FieldWorks identity as 'entryGuid:msaGuid' (a GUID or a Motif id), check an id's identity with 'id=entryGuid:msaGuid', and pin an allomorph with 'id@allomorphId'. One call reads candidates by id or by guid alone, not both.

at.description: 'baseline' (default) for the current Baseline, or a proposal id for that Draft or Proposal's latest Trial copy.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
